messages:
alice: FYI PR #2567 (migration-guide -> main) updates the SDK examples and the migration notes. Netlify preview is failing for the new embed example though. anyone free to eyeball?
ben: I'll take a look in a bit. error in preview? 502 or build timeout?
alice: build times out at `swr` step, then Netlify shows "Build failed: Error: spawn ENOMEM". preview link errors out with 504.
carla: @alice can you paste the Netlify deploy log snippet? sometimes caching node_modules helps.
alice: here: ```
12:03:45 PM: npm run build
12:04:10 PM: info Found lockfile
12:06:32 PM: ERROR Error: spawn ENOMEM
12:06:33 PM: Subprocess failed
```
netlify-bot: Preview deploy for PR #2567 started -> https://deploy-preview-2567--redwood-docs.netlify.app (status: failed)
zara: ENOMEM usually means exceeding memory on the free preview. can we reproduce locally with the same node version? try `nvm use 18` + `npm run docs:preview`
michael: also check if the embed example pulls a large dependency at build time (some client-only libs sneak into SSR). quick grep: `yarn why heavy-embed-lib`?
ben: ok I'm spinning up a local preview. quick tip: if you get weird netlify build cache issues, force a fresh build by clearing the Netlify cache or set `NETLIFY_USE_YARN=false` in env to match CI.
alice: local with `NODE_VERSION=18.17.1 npm run docs:preview` fails for me too, same ENOMEM after image optimization step.
carla: image optimization often kills memory. temp workaround: disable the image optimizer in next.config.js for the preview branch — add `images: { disableStaticImages: true }` or use `export: true`?
zara: alternative: build with `NEXT_PRIVATE_IMAGES=true` env var (we use that in some PRs). if that works we can add a note in CONTRIBUTING for local preview.
michael: I'm +1 for a CONTRIBUTING note. but for this PR we need reviewers and a merge window. per process: 2 approvals + green docs preview before merge. right now preview is failing so we can't merge.
ben: I can review after I confirm the embed example doesn't bundle server-only deps. @carla can you do a quick pass on wording?
carla: yes. I'll run `npx why heavy-embed-lib` and check. if it's only client, we can wrap import in `if (typeof window !== 'undefined')` or use dynamic import: `const Embed = dynamic(() => import('heavy-embed-lib'), { ssr: false })`.
alice: thanks. if we add the dynamic import change, does Netlify still need the big dep at build time? it shouldn't.
netlify-bot: New commit pushed to PR #2567: hash abc123 -> starting preview rebuild
netlify-bot: Preview deploy for PR #2567 completed -> https://deploy-preview-2567--redwood-docs.netlify.app (status: succeeded) :tada:
zara: awesome, I can see the embed example in the preview now. can reviewers confirm the example matches SDK style guide?
ben: quick skim: API shape looks right, but please add a short code comment about error handling and a link to the SDK snippets page. small nit.
carla: wording tweak suggestion sent in a tiny commit.
michael: once we have 2 approvals and the preview link stays stable for 10 minutes, schedule merge in the midnight merge window (00:30 UTC) — we have a batch of doc-only merges then to reduce churn.
alice: noted. tagging reviewers: @ben @carla. thanks for the help everyone :pray:
ben: approving now, added :white_check_mark:.
carla: approved.
michael: all checks green and 2 approvals. leaving the merge to alice or release eng for the 00:30UTC window.
alice: I'll merge in the 00:30UTC window. PR description updated with local preview steps and `NODE_VERSION` note per zara's suggestion. added a short entry to CONTRIBUTING about `npm run docs:preview` reproducer.
ben: thanks — great checklist addition. :thumbsup:
carla: if anyone hits the preview ENOMEM again, try `NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=4096` for the build step as a fallback.
alice: tracked in the PR checklist and in the docs backlog. closing thread after merge.
note: thread focuses on docs PR review, Netlify preview fail, local repro and merge timing
